translations.web: For it is better, if it is God’s will, that you suffer for doing well than for doing evil.
translations.bsb: For it is better, if it is God’s will, to suffer for doing good than for doing evil.
translations.kjv: For it is better, if the will of God be so, that ye suffer for well doing, than for evil doing.
translations.asv: For it is better, if the will of God should so will, that ye suffer for well-doing than for evil-doing.
